approved.text: A CEO makes a personal mistake in shareholders pay. A government mismanages its currencies. and its savers pay. Bitcoin's rules aren't kept by a single executive or a single central bank. They're enforced by thousands of independent computers running the same code. No CEO, no compromise, no committee to debate.
approved.why: first seconds too dry to halt scrolls

approved.text: Currencies are often born for political reasons, but fail for economic reasons. Bitcoin launched in January of 2009. It's never been renamed. It's never gone into another currency. It's never been redenominated or reissued.
approved.why: dry academic opener lacks scroll-stopping punch
